title: 88Vape Any Tank Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sweet Strawberry from 88Vape is a deliciously sweet and simple strawberry flavour. The classic summer berry is a flavour that never goes out of fashion, and here the flavour is reproduced in all its sweet, juicy, succulent, sun-ripened glory. This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 50/50 e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss. Please Note: that the 6mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 11mg & 16mg nicotine strengths contain 30VG/70PG.
